title: Fluid design implementation + read mode
goal: The approved design in the engine: typography, rhythm, light/dark, caret/selection colours, minimal chrome (mode toggle, save state), responsive behaviour, read mode with CSS multi-column on wide viewports.
scope: CSS with exactly the approved values from docs/adr/0002-fluid-design.md
Read-mode toggle (shortcut + button); columns only in read mode above the approved threshold

rules.rule: Only the approved values; deviations need Joel.
Do not copy layout, text or brand of the bars.

floor: UA-default rendering of the same fixture

criteria: Screens of the EN and DE fixtures at 390/768/1280/1920 × light/dark on chromium, webkit, firefox, ios-safari and android-chrome.
No layout shift while typing (CLS 0 in a scenario run).
Read mode: columns above the threshold, none below; the ghost stays inert; find count 1.
acceptance.critic: Blind visual vs the bar and vs the floor (neutral file names, labels stripped); ours must win both.
